Name: Emily with Tattoos (Updated for 1.6)
Author: elyk07
Description:
**UPDATED for 1.6** Now includes sprites and portraits for both beach/resort and winter. 

1.6.0 Update Notes: I didn't change her winter look much, but at least now it won't revert back to her original face for the winter season. Additionally, I fixed some minor issues with the non-winter sprite. 

Emily always seemed like she'd look great with tattoos to me. She also looks a little bit more like Haley now. It's hard to really see what the tattoos are, but I tried to use images of things that she actually likes. She has a daffodil on her left shoulder, a 'sign of the vessel' on her right arm, and 2 parrots in flight on her chest (you can really only see a bit of the wings). 

To use this, just copy the xnb files into the "Characters" and "Portraits" folder for your game. 

If you installed the game to the default Steam folder, those folders are located here: 
C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Content\

This will not work with mod manager install. You'll need to manually copy over those xnb files. Backup up the original files first in case you want to undo the change. 

Credit where credit is due: I used kamirose's Haley as a base from their "Character Portrait Overhaul" mod. I also used Chrysanthe's Emily hair style from their "Refined Abigale and Emily Portraits" mod. I wasn't trying to steal anyone else's work, so definitely go check out those mods if you'd like the original content. They did a great job. I just mod'd the mod for my own personal enjoyment and figured I'd share in case anyone else would like an Emily with tattoos.
